verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken skyscraper layout. The reading order is scrambled: 'FREYA ANOUK' sits above the headline and 'ONLINE TRAINING BY' is stranded at the bottom, cut off from the name. There are huge empty white gaps between the pieces, the second photo has shrunk to a tiny unreadable thumbnail, and yellow blocks sit on top of the main photo instead of behind the headline. A is slightly less bad because its two yellow bars cover less of the athlete than B's large bracket shape.
